description: E147 s0 (D2): where each value of a manifest's citation, its files and its tables goes in the three standard descriptors a release carries beside its manifest. This is the documented table (the README renders it row for row); what a reader compares is the three projections of descriptors.py, which hold the same places. A value outside a row is free: a writer may add keywords, names or anything else the standard allows.

descriptors.datacite.json: DataCite kernel-4.3 JSON (without identifiers until a DOI is registered)

rows.ro_crate: root `./`; a File's `@id` is its manifest path; a creator's is its identifier or `#creator-<n>` (from 1); the publisher's its identifier or `#publisher`
rows.croissant: a FileObject's `@id` is its manifest path; a recordSet's the table's name; a field's `<table>/<field>`; creators and publisher as in RO-Crate

rows.ro_crate: root `author`: the creators' `@id`s in order; each node `@type` `Person` or `Organization`, `name`
root `license` `#licence`: a `CreativeWork` named `No open licence` whose `description` is the notice
root `hasPart`: the set of their paths with `manifest.json` and `prov.json`; each a File with `sha256`, `contentSize` (the bytes as a string), `encodingFormat` (the row's `media_type`); no other File
rows.croissant: `distribution`: one FileObject each, `contentUrl` (the path), `sha256`, `contentSize` `<bytes> B`, `encodingFormat`; no other
rows.datacite: `sizes` [`<total> bytes`], `formats` the sorted distinct media types; no file digest

rows.source: tables (a /2 folder's table-target items; from 2.16 a bundle's typed tables)
rows.croissant: one `recordSet` per table, its `field` the field `@id`s in target order; each field `name`, `dataType` (field kinds), `source.fileObject` (the item's path, or the asset's `data.json`), `source.extract.column` (folder: the field's name) or `source.extract.jsonPath` (bundle: the path of the bundle tables table, and no `column`)

rows.ro_crate: File `prov.json`: `sha256`, `contentSize`, `encodingFormat` `application/json`, `conformsTo` `https://www.w3.org/submissions/prov-json/`; a /2 folder's PROV is its `lineage/prov.json` row
